event.title: Irish Man Charged with Destroying US Military Plane During Protest
event.canonical_title: Irish Man Charged with Destroying US Military Plane During Protest
event.summary: Daithí O’Corrain has been charged with destroying a US military aircraft valued at $60 million during a protest. Supporters claim his actions were a political demonstration against US military involvement in conflicts such as the war with Iran and military aid to Israel. The incident reportedly involved an hours-long raid, as described by the FBI.

timeline.summary: On November 20, 2026, thousands of students marched through Berlin to protest Germany's rapid military rearmament and the potential return of compulsory military service. This demonstration is part of a broader wave of youth protests occurring across Europe.
key_facts: Thousands of students participated in the protest.
